verified_facts.text: La Mamounia's most recent transformation was conceived in 2020 and 2023 by designers Sanjit Manku and Patrick Jouin.
verified_facts.excerpt: the extraordinary metamorphosis conceived in 2020 and 2023 by Sanjit Manku and Patrick Jouin

verified_facts.text: The lobby features the Centenary Chandelier, a light sculpture that pays homage to traditional Berber jewellery.
verified_facts.excerpt: culminating in the fabulous Centenary Chandelier. This magnificent sculpture of light, which pays homage to traditional Berber jewellery, captivates the eye from the moment you walk through the hotel doors

verified_facts.text: The hotel has pools, a gym, tennis courts and gardens planted with roses, orange, olive and palm trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: the pools, gym, tennis courts and shady walkways in the sublime Gardens, awash with roses, orange, olive and palm trees, are all there just waiting for you

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a spa with hammams.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spa and hammams are the perfect place to indulge in a spot of pampering.

verified_facts.text: A vintage games room in the gardens has pinball and a pool table.
verified_facts.excerpt: tucked away in the Gardens, a delightful vintage games room will tempt young and old alike to fight it out over a game of pinball, pool table

verified_facts.text: The Koutoubia Mosque, Place Jamaa el-Fna and the Medina are a few minutes from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: In just a few minutes, you will be before the magnificent Koutoubia Mosque, then in the bustling Place Jamaa el-Fna or the narrow streets of the Medina

verified_facts.text: The hotel can organise excursions to sights such as the Majorelle Gardens with a private guide and driver.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Majorelle Gardens, the Bahia Palace, the Saadian Tombs, the Palmeraie - we will be delighted to organise your excursions, providing you with your own guide and driver

verified_facts.text: Pierre Herme runs two tea rooms: Le Menzeh in the gardens and a tea room on the Andalusian patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: choose between the charming Menzeh par Pierre Hermé in the heart of the Gardens or the dazzling Andalusian patio

verified_facts.text: Pierre Herme created exclusive Date and Earl Grey and Amlou macarons for La Mamounia's afternoon tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: his exclusive creations for La Mamounia, the Date and Earl Grey and Amlou Macarons

verified_facts.text: The restaurants include Asian cuisine by Jean-Georges Vongerichten, Italian by Simone Zanoni and Moroccan by Chef Rachid Agouray.
verified_facts.excerpt: Moroccan flavours infused with spices and reimagined by Chef Rachid Agouray, vibrant Italian specialities by Simone Zanoni, or a grand culinary journey through Asia curated by Jean-Georges Vongerichten

verified_facts.text: Le Pavillon de la Piscine serves poolside buffet lunches on a shaded terrace and hosts Sunday Brunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: The shaded terrace of the Pavillon de la Piscine invites you to enjoy classic dishes and light specialities from the sumptuous buffets that accompany your poolside lunches.

verified_facts.text: Le Pavillon de la Piscine is the place for Sunday Brunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: This is also the place to head for Sunday Brunch

verified_facts.text: The kitchens draw herbs and vegetables from the hotel's own kitchen garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: a quick stroll through La Mamounia's vibrant kitchen garden is all it takes to find a wealth of fresh herbs and vegetables

verified_facts.text: A small cinema in blue velvet is hidden behind a sliding door.
verified_facts.excerpt: In a haven of blue velvet, concealed behind a sliding door, lies a delightful little Cinéma.

verified_facts.text: Three large lanterns house the Oenotheque wine space and two private lounges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three large Lanternes house the extraordinary Œnothèque and two private lounges

verified_facts.text: The three Riads have their own private entrances, pools and terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: With their own private entrances, pools and terraces, our Riads allow you to enjoy La Mamounia experience, tucked away from view and in complete serenity.

verified_facts.text: All bathrooms have a separate shower and bathtub, finished in marble and mashrabiya wooden latticework.
verified_facts.excerpt: our bathrooms, all with separate shower and bathtub, sumptuously decked out in marble and mashrabiya wooden latticework

verified_facts.text: Rooms look over the Gardens, the pool, the Hivernage area or the Koutoubia Mosque.
verified_facts.excerpt: whichever room you choose, you'll enjoy wonderful views over the Gardens, pool, Hivernage area or the Koutoubia Mosque

verified_facts.text: Suites have one to three bedrooms and suit families and friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring one to three bedrooms, our range of suites are ideal for families and friends.

verified_facts.text: Exceptional Suite guests get a private transfer between the hotel and Marrakech-Menara airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests in our Exceptional Suites also benefit from a private transfer between the hotel and the Marrakech-Menara airport.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 6 km from Marrakech-Menara airport, about 10 minutes by car.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Mamounia is located at 6 km from the airport “Marrakech-Menara”. A journey time of 10 minutes by car.

verified_facts.text: A minimum stay is required for certain periods, including Easter, All Saints and the end-of-year festivities.
verified_facts.excerpt: A minimum stay is required for certain periods during the year including Easter, All Saints and for the end of year festivities.

verified_facts.text: Room service offers a selection of the hotel's menus at all times.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our room service offers a gourmet selection of our various menus at all times.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says it became a hotel in the early 1900s and guests included FDR and Churchill.
verified_facts.excerpt: Turned into a hotel in the early 1900s and owned in part by the royal family, everyone from FDR to Churchill stayed here.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists La Mamounia in its Readers' Choice Awards every year from 2017 to 2026.

subjective.text: The hotel says it has been nominated the best hotel in the world on several occasions.
